chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Ahmad ibn Abi Ali, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), regarding

a man who performed an exclusive Umrah, so he slept with his wife while he was in Ihram, before he finished his Tawaf and Saee. He (peace be upon him) said: Upon him is a camel for the spoiling of his Umrah, and upon him is that he stays in Makkah until another month enters, so he goes out to one of the Miqat points, enters Ihram from it, then performs Umrah.

key_terms.مَحْرُوم: One in the state of Ihram (ritual consecration)
key_terms.مَوَاقِيت: Miqat points (ritual boundary stations for entering Ihram)

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for sexual intercourse during Umrah before completing Tawaf and Saee?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) specifies that sexual intercourse during Umrah al-Mufrada invalidates the pilgrimage, requiring the expiation of a camel (badanah) and a mandatory stay in Mecca until the next lunar month. This ruling highlights the distinct severity applied to Umrah compared to Hajj, where the pilgrim must exit to a Miqat to renew Ihram for a fresh performance, underscoring the integrity of the ritual state in Shia fiqh.
